mapper.sql: select diaper_id, baby_id, record_time, diaper_type, stool_texture, notes, operator_id, operator_name, rev, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_by_name, update_time, remark from nc_diaper
mapper.select: select to_char(record_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as label, sum(case when diaper_type in ('pee', 'both') then 1 else 0 end)::int as count, sum(case when diaper_type in ('poop', 'both') then 1 else 0 end)::int as extra from nc_diaper where baby_id = #{babyId} and del_flag = '0' and record_time::date >= current_date - (#{days}::int - 1) group by to_char(record_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by label

select count(*)::int as count, sum(case when stool_texture in ('watery', 'bloody', 'mucus', 'other') then 1 else 0 end)::int as extra from nc_diaper where baby_id = #{babyId} and del_flag = '0' and record_time::date = current_date
mapper.update: update nc_diaper set record_time = #{recordTime}, diaper_type = #{diaperType}, stool_texture = #{stoolTexture}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_by_name = #{updateByName}, rev = rev + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where diaper_id = #{diaperId} and del_flag = '0' and rev = #{rev}
